parameters.content:
## WF-MGMT-01: Weekly Retrospective

**Trigger:** Friday 6 PM ET
**Purpose:** Generate comprehensive weekly retrospective

### Data Sources:
- Jira tickets (all projects)
- Trade performance & grades
- Incident reports
- Agent activity logs
- CEO approval decisions
- System uptime metrics

### Outputs:
1. MGMT ticket with full summary
2. Discord embed to #ceo-briefing
3. Markdown archive to Brain
4. Audit log entry

### Metrics Calculated:
- Sprint velocity by project
- Trading P&L & win rate
- System reliability %
- Agent efficiency ratio
- Approval rates

## AI Retrospective Generation

Claude generates structured retrospective:
- What went well (celebrate wins)
- What went wrong (honest assessment)
- What to improve (actionable items)
- Next week focus areas
- Team kudos

Max 500 words, data-driven analysis.
